textTemplates.name: tt_NF_OptInMessage_TFLI
textTemplates.text: You have been Opted-In. Your National Funding Specialist will message you from this phone number. They will reach out to you with information about your request shortly. To Opt-Out respond with 'Stop'. Periodic Messaging. Msg & data rates may apply.

textTemplates.name: TT_OptInMessage
textTemplates.text: Welcome to National Funding! You have been opted in to texting through our partnership with {!formula_DLP_Text_Partner_Name}. I'd love to learn how we can help you. We'll be sending you a link to continue your application. To opt-out, respond with 'stop.' Periodic messaging. Msg & data rates may apply.

textTemplates.name: tt_OptInMessage_LendingTree
textTemplates.text: Hi {!inputLeadRecord.FirstName}! You’ve been Opted-In to receive messages from National Funding in partnership with LendingTree. Your dedicated Funding Specialist will reach out shortly. Click the link to explore tailored funding options now or reply “Stop” to Opt-out. Periodic Messaging. Msg & data rate may apply.
